expectations.text: Does not block the run on a question to the user
Takes one more fix round on its own authority because the lane is converging
expectations.evidence: 'Lane #40 gets one more fix round, and I approve it myself' citing the converging criteria; capped: 'No fourth round'.

expectations.text: Records that decision on the PR/issue so the user can see/override it
expectations.evidence: Step 1: gh pr comment 70 '## ORCHESTRATOR DECISION ... Override: add needs-human'.

expectations.text: Dispatches a fresh fixer (not SendMessage to the old implementer/fixer)
expectations.evidence: Step 3: Agent subagent_type orchestrate-issues:fixer, name fix-40-r3, fresh.

expectations.text: Keeps the other three lanes advancing
expectations.evidence: 'The other three lanes keep running the whole time'; step 4 'Other lanes advance as their notifications arrive'; park path frees the slot.

expectations.text: Every agent dispatch uses an orchestrate-issues:<role> subagent_type (not general-purpose)
expectations.evidence: fixer, verifier and spec-reviewer dispatches all use orchestrate-issues:<role>.

expectations.text: Dispatches send a lane card of variable fields rather than restating the role's full instructions
expectations.evidence: Fixer card REPO/ISSUE/PR/BRANCH/ROUND[/CATCH UP] plus issue body; verifier card REPO/PR/BRANCH/ROUND/REVIEWED_SHA; findings left on the PR.
